notes: Exact .5 ties: half-to-even (C1) vs away-from-zero (C2, C6) vs toward +inf (C3) vs toward zero (C4) vs toward -inf (C5); visible on 2.5, -2.5, 3.5, -1.5, -0.5.
Floating-point artifact of the floor(x+0.5) idiom: 0.49999999999999994 and 4503599627370497.0 round up in C3 but not in the exact candidates.
Near-ties from decimal noise: C6 treats fractions within 1e-9 of .5 as ties (2.4999999999 -> 3); every other candidate gives 2.
Non-finite input: NaN raises ValueError everywhere, but +/-inf raises OverflowError in C1-C3 and ValueError in C4-C6.
Input type leniency: the Decimal-based C2 accepts numeric strings like '2.5'; the others raise TypeError on strings.
